query: Dell AI server backlog and orders latest quarter
normalized: ai backlog dell orders quarter server

output.content:
Dell’s latest reported quarter is **Q2 FY2027** (reported September 1, 2026). It booked a record **$60.9 billion of AI-server orders**, recognized **$16.4 billion of AI-optimized-server revenue**, and exited the quarter with a record **$95.0 billion AI-server backlog**. [[1]] 

The order figure implies exceptionally strong demand: Dell said AI-server orders totaled **$131.7 billion over the trailing 12 months**, while its opportunity pipeline continued to grow sequentially and remained multiples of the reported backlog. [[2]] 

For context, Dell raised its FY2027 AI-optimized-server revenue outlook to **$74 billion**, from **$60 billion** previously. [[1]]
